name: Unita

sources.title: Unita - discover, compare and review communities

requirements: Only online communities, masterminds, or groups - either ones you own or ones you participate in
Account required: 'You must be logged in to post new listings' (sign in or register at /my-account/)
Listing is free per the page title/meta: 'Add your online community to our directory... For free!'
Platform-aware: listings are organized by Slack, Discord, Telegram, Circle, Reddit, LinkedIn, Twitter, etc.
preparation: Community name, join URL, description, platform (Slack/Discord/Telegram/etc.), and category (Business, Design, Marketing, No Code, Crypto, etc.)
workflow: Complete the listing form (rendered behind the login state)
Submit for review; listing appears in the communities directory
watchFor: The form area is JS-rendered and only appears when logged in - fields are not publicly visible
This is a communities directory, not a product directory - submitting a SaaS product itself is off-topic
A separate Sponsorship page exists for paid promotion - not required to list
WordPress-based (wp-content paths); some pages may be slow
countsAsLive: The community appears in Unita's explore-communities listings under its platform and category pages.
unknowns: Exact listing form fields behind login
